reason: B directly targets refractory HEAs with a physically established oxide-dispersion mechanism that can strengthen at high temperature and provide irradiation-defect sinks, and it proposes comparative mechanical, creep, irradiation, and microstructural tests. A misclassifies CoCrFeNi/CoCrFeMnNi as refractory alloys, extrapolates room-temperature ion-irradiation observations to high-temperature service, and does not establish that greater dislocation density or compressive stress yields improved mechanical performance.
